--!strict
-- BuildArena.lua  |  World of Void greybox v1 (arena + lobby)
-- Run: paste in Studio Command Bar, or place as a Script in ServerScriptService.
-- Idempotent: destroys Workspace.WorldOfVoid before rebuilding.
-- Spec: /workspace/roblox/team/map/layout_spec.md

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local ROOT_NAME = "WorldOfVoid"

-- ===== Config (studs) =====
local ARENA_Y = 500
local RINGOUT_LOW_Y = 480     -- below this for >1s = ring-out (flight allowed)            -- ring top surface height
local RING_DIAMETER = 300
local RING_THICK = 20
local STANDS_RADIUS = 420      -- center distance of universe stand blocks
local STANDS_Y = 540
local ZENO_POS = Vector3.new(0, 700, -520)
local RINGOUT_Y = 420          -- falling below this = ring-out
local RINGOUT_RADIUS = 175     -- horizontal distance from ring center = ring-out
local LOBBY_ORIGIN = Vector3.new(3000, 100, 0)

local C_VOID = Color3.fromRGB(20, 18, 40)
local C_RING = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
local C_EDGE = Color3.fromRGB(120, 90, 200)
local C_ZENO = Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 90)
local C_LOBBY = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185)

-- ===== Helpers =====
local function folder(name: string, parent: Instance): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

local function part(props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance, tags: {string}?): BasePart
	local p: BasePart
	if props.Shape == "Cylinder" then
		local pp = Instance.new("Part")
		pp.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		p = pp
	elseif props.Shape == "Wedge" then
		p = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	else
		p = Instance.new("Part")
	end
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or C_RING
	p.Size = props.Size
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame
	p.Name = props.Name
	if props.Transparency then p.Transparency = props.Transparency end
	if props.CanCollide ~= nil then p.CanCollide = props.CanCollide end
	if props.CanTouch ~= nil then p.CanTouch = props.CanTouch end
	if props.CanQuery ~= nil then p.CanQuery = props.CanQuery end
	p.Parent = parent
	if tags then
		for _, t in ipairs(tags) do CollectionService:AddTag(p, t) end
	end
	return p
end

-- Cylinder whose axis is vertical (Roblox cylinders run along X by default)
local function vcyl(center: Vector3): CFrame
	return CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
end

local function spawnPad(name: string, pos: Vector3, parent: Instance, tag: string, team: string?)
	local s = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	s.Name = name
	s.Anchored = true
	s.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
	s.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	s.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255)
	s.Neutral = true
	s.Enabled = (tag == "LobbySpawn")
	s.Duration = 0
	s.Parent = parent
	CollectionService:AddTag(s, tag)
	if team then s:SetAttribute("Universe", team) end
end

-- ===== Clear old =====
local old = Workspace:FindFirstChild(ROOT_NAME)
if old then old:Destroy() end
local root = folder(ROOT_NAME, Workspace)
root:SetAttribute("Version", "v1-greybox")

-- ===== ARENA =====
local arena = folder("Arena", root)
local ringF = folder("Ring", arena)
local ringCenter = Vector3.new(0, ARENA_Y - RING_THICK / 2, 0)

-- Destructible chunk grid (polar): 5 radial bands x sectors {6,12,18,24,30} = 90 chunks.
-- Each chunk is a box approximating its annular sector; Y 480..500. Tag "RingChunk".
local chunkF = folder("Chunks", ringF)
local BANDS = { {0, 30, 6}, {30, 60, 12}, {60, 90, 18}, {90, 120, 24}, {120, 150, 30} }
for bi, b in ipairs(BANDS) do
	local r0, r1, n = b[1], b[2], b[3]
	local rm = (r0 + r1) / 2
	local depth = r1 - r0
	for si = 1, n do
		local a = math.rad((si - 0.5) * 360 / n)
		local arc = 2 * math.pi * (bi == 1 and r1 or rm) / n + 1 -- +1 overlap closes seams
		local pos = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * rm, ringCenter.Y, math.sin(a) * rm)
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(0, ringCenter.Y, 0))
		local c = part({ Name = string.format("Chunk_B%d_S%02d", bi, si), Size = Vector3.new(arc, RING_THICK, depth + 0.5),
			CFrame = cf, Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
			Color = (bi + si) % 2 == 0 and C_RING or Color3.fromRGB(185, 185, 196) }, chunkF, { "RingChunk", "ArenaFloor" })
		c:SetAttribute("Band", bi)
		c:SetAttribute("Sector", si)
		c:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", 60 + bi * 20) -- outer bands tougher (80..160)
		c:SetAttribute("Health", 60 + bi * 20)
		c:SetAttribute("HalfSpan", math.max(arc, depth) / 2)
	end
end
-- Underside cone approximation: stacked shrinking discs
for i = 1, 4 do
	local d = RING_DIAMETER - i * 55
	part({ Name = "Ring_Under_" .. i, Shape = "Cylinder", Size = Vector3.new(15, d, d),
		CFrame = vcyl(Vector3.new(0, ARENA_Y - RING_THICK - i * 15 + 7.5, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Rock,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 85, 100), CanCollide = false, CanTouch = false }, ringF)
end
-- 8 decorative pillars on the rim (broken-cover, collidable)
for i = 0, 7 do
	local a = math.rad(i * 45 + 22.5)
	local r = RING_DIAMETER / 2 - 20
	part({ Name = "Ring_Pillar_" .. (i + 1), Size = Vector3.new(8, 30, 8),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * r, ARENA_Y + 15, math.sin(a) * r), Material = Enum.Material.Marble,
		Color = C_RING }, ringF, { "ArenaCover" })
end

-- Fighter spawns: 12 universes x 1 pad each on an r=110 circle (match logic picks pads)
local spawnF = folder("Spawns", arena)
for u = 1, 12 do
	local a = math.rad((u - 1) * 30)
	spawnPad(string.format("Spawn_Ring_U%02d", u), Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 110, ARENA_Y + 0.5, math.sin(a) * 110),
		spawnF, "ArenaSpawn", string.format("U%02d", u))
end

-- Universe stands: 12 floating blocks around the ring, facing center
local standsF = folder("Stands", arena)
for u = 1, 12 do
	local a = math.rad((u - 1) * 30)
	local pos = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * STANDS_RADIUS, STANDS_Y, math.sin(a) * STANDS_RADIUS)
	local look = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(0, STANDS_Y, 0))
	local uf = folder(string.format("Stand_U%02d", u), standsF)
	uf:SetAttribute("Universe", u)
	part({ Name = "Base", Size = Vector3.new(80, 4, 40), CFrame = look, Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
		Color = Color3.fromHSV((u - 1) / 12, 0.45, 0.8) }, uf, { "UniverseStand" })
	for row = 1, 3 do -- tiered seating steps going back/up
		part({ Name = "Tier_" .. row, Size = Vector3.new(80, 4 * row, 8),
			CFrame = look * CFrame.new(0, 2 * row + 2, 4 + row * 8), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120) }, uf)
	end
	part({ Name = "Banner", Size = Vector3.new(40, 20, 1), CFrame = look * CFrame.new(0, 30, 20),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = Color3.fromHSV((u - 1) / 12, 0.8, 1), CanCollide = false }, uf)
	spawnPad(string.format("Spawn_Stand_U%02d", u), (look * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, -10)).Position, uf, "StandSpawn",
		string.format("U%02d", u))
end

-- Zeno's viewing box (elevated, behind stands at -Z)
local zenoF = folder("ZenoBox", arena)
local zl = CFrame.lookAt(ZENO_POS, Vector3.new(0, ARENA_Y, 0))
part({ Name = "Zeno_Floor", Size = Vector3.new(60, 4, 40), CFrame = zl, Material = Enum.Material.Marble, Color = C_ZENO }, zenoF, { "ZenoBox" })
part({ Name = "Zeno_BackWall", Size = Vector3.new(60, 30, 2), CFrame = zl * CFrame.new(0, 17, 19), Color = C_ZENO }, zenoF)
part({ Name = "Zeno_Roof", Size = Vector3.new(64, 2, 44), CFrame = zl * CFrame.new(0, 33, 0), Color = C_ZENO }, zenoF)
part({ Name = "Zeno_Glass", Size = Vector3.new(60, 26, 1), CFrame = zl * CFrame.new(0, 15, -19.5),
	Material = Enum.Material.Glass, Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255), Transparency = 0.7 }, zenoF)
part({ Name = "Zeno_Throne_1", Size = Vector3.new(6, 8, 6), CFrame = zl * CFrame.new(-6, 6, 8), Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 160) }, zenoF)
part({ Name = "Zeno_Throne_2", Size = Vector3.new(6, 8, 6), CFrame = zl * CFrame.new(6, 6, 8), Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 160) }, zenoF)
spawnPad("Spawn_Zeno", (zl * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0)).Position, zenoF, "ZenoSpawn")

-- Ring-out zones (invisible, non-collidable triggers)
local zonesF = folder("Zones", arena)
part({ Name = "Zone_RingOut_Floor", Size = Vector3.new(4000, 10, 4000), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, RINGOUT_Y, 0),
	Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false }, zonesF, { "RingOutZone" })
local bounds = part({ Name = "Zone_RingBounds", Shape = "Cylinder", Size = Vector3.new(300, RINGOUT_RADIUS * 2, RINGOUT_RADIUS * 2),
	CFrame = vcyl(Vector3.new(0, ARENA_Y + 140, 0)), Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false }, zonesF, { "RingBounds" })
bounds:SetAttribute("Radius", RINGOUT_RADIUS)
bounds:SetAttribute("MinY", RINGOUT_Y)
bounds:SetAttribute("LowY", RINGOUT_LOW_Y)
bounds:SetAttribute("LowGrace", 1)
part({ Name = "Zone_Ceiling", Size = Vector3.new(2000, 4, 2000), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, ARENA_Y + 400, 0),
	Transparency = 1, CanTouch = false, CanQuery = false }, zonesF, { "ArenaCeiling" })

-- ===== LOBBY =====
local lobby = folder("Lobby", root)
local L = LOBBY_ORIGIN
part({ Name = "Lobby_Floor", Shape = "Cylinder", Size = Vector3.new(6, 240, 240), CFrame = vcyl(L - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)),
	Material = Enum.Material.Marble, Color = C_LOBBY }, lobby, { "LobbyFloor" })
part({ Name = "Lobby_Centerpiece", Shape = "Cylinder", Size = Vector3.new(4, 40, 40), CFrame = vcyl(L + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)),
	Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = C_EDGE }, lobby)
-- Queue pads (matchmaking) N/E/S/W
local pads = { { "Queue_Solo", Vector3.new(0, 0, -80) }, { "Queue_Team", Vector3.new(80, 0, 0) },
	{ "Shop", Vector3.new(0, 0, 80) }, { "Training", Vector3.new(-80, 0, 0) } }
for _, d in ipairs(pads) do
	part({ Name = "Lobby_" .. d[1], Size = Vector3.new(30, 1, 30), CFrame = CFrame.new(L + d[2] + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = C_ZENO }, lobby, { "LobbyPad" }):SetAttribute("PadType", d[1])
end
-- Perimeter wall segments
for i = 0, 23 do
	local a = math.rad(i * 15)
	local p = L + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 118, 10, math.sin(a) * 118)
	part({ Name = "Lobby_Wall_" .. (i + 1), Size = Vector3.new(2, 20, 32),
		CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p, Vector3.new(L.X, p.Y, L.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 140), Transparency = 0.3 }, lobby)
end
for i = 1, 8 do
	local a = math.rad(i * 45)
	spawnPad(string.format("Spawn_Lobby_%02d", i), L + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 40, 0.5, math.sin(a) * 40), lobby, "LobbySpawn")
end
part({ Name = "Zone_LobbyFall", Size = Vector3.new(1000, 10, 1000), CFrame = CFrame.new(L - Vector3.new(0, 80, 0)),
	Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false }, lobby, { "LobbyFallZone" })

-- ===== LIGHTING / SKY =====
for _, c in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
	if c:GetAttribute("WorldOfVoid") then c:Destroy() end
end
Lighting.ClockTime = 0
Lighting.Brightness = 2
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(70, 60, 110)
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(90, 80, 140)
Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.3
Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.5
Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
Lighting.FogColor = C_VOID
Lighting.FogStart = 800
Lighting.FogEnd = 4000

local function lit(inst: Instance)
	inst:SetAttribute("WorldOfVoid", true)
	inst.Parent = Lighting
end
local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
sky.Name = "WOV_Sky"
sky.StarCount = 3000
sky.CelestialBodiesShown = false
lit(sky) -- default textures; swap SkyboxBk/Dn/Ft/Lf/Rt/Up asset ids for a real void skybox
local atm = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
atm.Name = "WOV_Atmosphere"
atm.Density = 0.35
atm.Offset = 0.2
atm.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 180)
atm.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 60)
atm.Glare = 0
atm.Haze = 1.5
lit(atm)
local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
cc.Name = "WOV_ColorCorrection"
cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(225, 215, 255)
cc.Contrast = 0.1
cc.Saturation = 0.1
lit(cc)
local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
bloom.Name = "WOV_Bloom"
bloom.Intensity = 0.8
bloom.Size = 30
bloom.Threshold = 1.5
lit(bloom)

-- If ArenaDamage ModuleScript is installed, rescan the new chunks
local SSS = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local dmgMod = SSS:FindFirstChild("ArenaDamage")
if dmgMod and dmgMod:IsA("ModuleScript") and game:GetService("RunService"):IsServer() then
	local ok, err = pcall(function() (require(dmgMod) :: any).Init(root) end)
	if not ok then warn("[WorldOfVoid] ArenaDamage.Init failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
end

print(string.format("[WorldOfVoid] built %d descendants", #root:GetDescendants()))
